argument: Pressure must live in actual type production: the keystone word needs changed tracking, scale, slant, and weight while a non-local word receives changed tracking and baseline room. A halo, meter, or cursor cannot substitute for the redistribution.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, caption, and furniture hidden, the first field should read as one stacked typographic mass, not a sentence corridor, refusal plate, route rack, or generic word poster. After a hold, compressed and relieved words must be findable in the letter geometry.

A short press must be refused. Only a real hold followed by release, the deterministic control, Enter, or Space may commit; pointer position must not select the word. Delete restores the exact preceding loom and R releases bounded memory.

v027 changes at least two encounter dimensions: it leaves point pressure, literal typing, and approach/withdraw for global duration pressure, and it leaves sentence, clause, and route compositions for one stacked typographic body whose whitespace is the material.

Delete v027 if the loom is only an attractive word poster, if duration does not alter actual glyph geometry, if relief is local or cosmetic, if later holds restart from baseline, if a short tap writes, or if the blind body needs the caption to be read as a pressure system.
